prompt: Many companies now allow their staff to work from home for most of the week. Some people think this arrangement benefits employees, while others argue that it harms teamwork and the training of younger staff. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Since the pandemic, a lot of companies allow their staffs to work from the home. Some persons think that this is very good for the workers, however other persons think that it is bad for the team work and for the training of the young employees. This essay will discuss the both sides of this issue.

Firstly, working from home has many advantages for the employees. They do not need to spend the time in the traffic every morning, so they can sleep more and they are less tired. In addition, they can save the money on the transport and on the expensive lunch near the office. Furthermore, the parents can spend more time with their children, and this is very good for the family life. Many workers also say that they can concentrate better at home because the office is very noisy.

Secondly, there is also the disadvantages. When the team is not in the same place, the communication become more difficult. The workers cannot ask the quick question to their colleague, so they must write the email and wait for the answer. Moreover, the new employees learn by watching the experienced people, but on the video call this is not possible. Therefore they need more time to learn the job.

In conclusion, working from home has the advantages and the disadvantages for the companies and for the workers. I think that the companies should let the employees to choose, because every person is different and every job is different.
title: Working from home: good for people, bad for teams?
